visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white ribbed tank top, stands in a brightly lit indoor living room. She smiles and points her finger upward while talking to the camera. Behind her, a brown massage chair and a white fireplace mantel are visible. (2) The scene cuts to her holding several long, vibrant green Pandan leaves in front of a mirror, obscuring her face with her phone. (3) A close-up shows her hand holding several segments of the green leaves over a wooden cutting board in a kitchen setting. (4) A quick shot shows a cross-section of a green Pandan sponge cake with a light, airy texture. (5) Back to the woman in the living room, she continues speaking with animated facial expressions and hand gestures. (6) In the kitchen, hands place the green leaf segments into a blender jar. (7) The blender is activated, spinning the green leaves into a frothy, bright green liquid. (8) The woman is seen holding a spoon with the green liquid, tasting it, and reacting with a squinted, disgusted facial expression. (9) She stands back in the living room, waving her hand and talking about the taste. (10) A close-up shows the green liquid being poured through a metal strainer into a white pot on a black stovetop. (11) Using pink-tipped tongs, she lifts a mass of bright green fibrous pulp from the strainer, showing its texture. (12) A can of coconut milk is poured into the pot containing the green liquid. (13) Four small glass jars filled with a translucent green jelly dessert are shown. (14) She holds a yellow lemon and a green lime in her hands. (15) Two glasses of a pale green, frothy iced drink are presented on a table. (16) A man in a white t-shirt and red shorts is briefly shown sitting at a desk, holding one of the glasses and looking skeptically at it. (17) Finally, the woman returns to the living room shot, pointing upward and smiling at the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog and mini-cooking tutorial focused on introducing and processing fresh Pandan leaves. The creator captures the curiosity of a 'special ingredient,' demonstrates the preparation steps (blending, straining, cooking), and provides a humorous review based on personal and peer reactions, aiming to engage and entertain a food-interested audience.
